meaning: (縄・ひも・包帯などで…に)…を縛る,結わえる,縛り付ける《+名+up+(+up+名)+to+名+with+名》 / 〈ひも・ネクタイ・リボンなど〉を結ぶ;〈衣類など〉のひもを結ぶ / 〈結び目・ちょう結びなど〉を結んで作る / (仕事・時間・場所などに)〈人〉を縛り付けたようにする,束縛する《+名+up(+up+名)+to(at)+名》 / (競技などで)〈相手・相手の得点・記録〉と同じになる,タイになる / 〈同じ高さの2音符〉をタイ(連結線)で結ぶ / 結べる,結び目を作る,縛られる / (…と)同じになる《+with+名》 / (縛るのに用いる)糸,ひも,綱 / 《しばしば複数形で》つながり,きずな,縁 / (また《おもに米》necktie)ネクタイ / (競技・試合・投票などの)同点;引き分けの試合 / 《米》(鉄道の)まくら木(《英》sleeper);(建築の)つなぎ材 / 《英》束縛するもの,じゃまもの,やっかいもの / (音譜の)連結線,タイ(同じ高さの2音を結んで,「切らずに演奏せよ」の記号)

definitions.definitionEn: A knot; a fastening.
A knot of hair, as at the back of a wig.
A necktie (item of clothing consisting of a strip of cloth tied around the neck). See also bow tie, black tie.
The situation in which two or more participants in a competition are placed equally.

example.en: It's two outs in the bottom of the ninth, tie score.
example.ja: 第九十九条の二項に規定するネクタイの得点である。

definitions.definitionEn: A twist tie, a piece of wire embedded in paper, strip of plastic with ratchets, or similar object which is wound around something and tightened.
A strong connection between people or groups of people.

example.en: the sacred ties of friendship or of duty
example.ja: 友情とか義務という神聖なきずな

definitions.definitionEn: A structural member firmly holding two pieces together.

example.en: Ties work to maintain structural integrity in windstorms and earthquakes.
example.ja: 風や地震の際には、構造上の忠誠を保つために、鎖が働いています。

definitions.definitionEn: A horizontal wooden or concrete structural member that supports and ties together rails.
The situation at the end of all innings of a match where both sides have the same total of runs (different from a draw).
A meeting between two players or teams in a competition.

example.en: The FA Cup third round tie between Liverpool and Cardiff was their first meeting in the competition since 1957.
example.ja: リバプールとカーディフの間にあった FA ワールドカップ第 3 ラウンド・ネクタイは、 1957 年以来この競技会で初めて開かれたものです。

definitions.definitionEn: A curved line connecting two notes of the same pitch denoting that they should be played as a single note with the combined length of both notes.
One or more equal values or sets of equal values in the data set.
A bearing and distance between a lot corner or point and a benchmark or iron off site.
A connection between two vertices.
A tiewig.
To twist (a string, rope, or the like) around itself securely.

example.en: Tie the rope to this tree.
example.ja: この木に綱を結べ

definitions.definitionEn: To form (a knot or the like) in a string or the like.

example.en: Tie a knot in this rope for me, please.
example.ja: このロープで結んでください

definitions.definitionEn: To attach or fasten (one thing to another) by string or the like.

example.en: Tie him to the tree.
example.ja: 木に縛れ

definitions.definitionEn: To secure (something) by string or the like.

example.en: Tie your shoes.
example.ja: 靴を結べ

definitions.definitionEn: To have the same score or position as another in a competition or ordering.

example.en: They tied for third place.
example.ja: 3位に縛られた

definitions.definitionEn: To have the same score or position as (another) in a competition or ordering.

example.en: He tied me for third place.
example.ja: 3位に縛られた

definitions.definitionEn: To unite (musical notes) with a line or slur in the notation.
To believe; to credit.
In the Perl programming language, to extend (a variable) so that standard operations performed upon it invoke custom functionality instead.

meaning: 内側の,内部にある / 国内の(domestic) / 内からとる,内用の

definitions.definitionEn: Inside of something

example.en: We saw the internal compartments.
example.ja: 中小室を見た。

definitions.definitionEn: Within the body

example.en: Her bleeding was internal.
example.ja: 出血は内部だった

definitions.definitionEn: Concerned with the domestic affairs of a nation, state or other political community.

example.en: The nation suffered from internal conflicts.
example.ja: 国民は国内紛争に苦しんでいた。

definitions.definitionEn: Concerned with the non-public affairs of a company or other organisation

example.en: An internal investigation was conducted.
example.ja: 内部調査が実施された。

meaning: 鎖;(装飾用の)鎖 / 《複数形で》束縛,拘束;囚人をつなぐ鎖 / (物事の)連続,つながり《+of+名》 / (商店・銀行・ホテルなどの)チェーン(一連の店が同一資本のもとで連携して経営される方式;その店) / チェーン(測量で用いられる単位;約21.7m) / …を鎖でつなぐ《+up(together)+名,+名+up(together)》

definitions.definitionEn: A series of interconnected rings or links usually made of metal.

example.en: He wore a gold chain around the neck.
example.ja: 首に金の鎖をつけてた

definitions.definitionEn: A series of interconnected things.

example.en: This led to an unfortunate chain of events.
example.ja: その結果、不幸な出来事が連鎖的に生じました。

definitions.definitionEn: A series of stores or businesses with the same brand name.

example.en: That chain of restaurants is expanding into our town.
example.ja: レストランのチェーンが町に広がってる

definitions.definitionEn: A number of atoms in a series, which combine to form a molecule.

example.en: When examined, the molecular chain included oxygen and hydrogen.
example.ja: 調べてみると、分子の鎖には酸素と水素が含まれていました。

definitions.definitionEn: A series of interconnected links of known length, used as a measuring device.
A long measuring tape.
A unit of length equal to 22 yards. The length of a Gunter's surveying chain. The length of a cricket pitch. Equal to 20.12 metres, 4 rods, or 100 links.
A totally ordered set, especially a totally ordered subset of a poset.
A sequence of linked house purchases, each of which is dependent on the preceding and succeeding purchase (said to be "broken" if a buyer or seller pulls out).
That which confines, fetters, or secures; a bond.

example.en: the chains of habit
example.ja: 習慣という鎖

definitions.definitionEn: (in the plural) Iron links bolted to the side of a vessel to bold the dead-eyes connected with the shrouds; also, the channels.
The warp threads of a web.
To fasten something with a chain.
To link multiple items together.
To secure someone with fetters.
To obstruct the mouth of a river etc with a chain.
To obligate.
To relate data items with a chain of pointers.
To be chained to another data item.
To measure a distance using a 66-foot long chain, as in land surveying.
(associated with Acorn Computers) To load and automatically run (a program).

meaning: 文学
example: The course introduces students to modern Japanese literature.

definitions.definitionEn: The body of all written works.
The collected creative writing of a nation, people, group or culture.
(usually preceded by the) All the papers, treatises etc. published in academic journals on a particular subject.
Written fiction of a high standard.

example.en: However, even “literary” science fiction rarely qualifies as literature, because it treats characters as sets of traits rather than as fully realized human beings with unique life stories. —Adam Cadre, 2008
example.ja: しかし、「字義的」な SF でさえ、文学としての資格を得ることはめったにありません。

meaning: (…の)犠牲者,被害者(物)《+of+名》 / だまされる人;(…の)食いもの,えじき《+of+名》 / (神にささげる)いけにえ

definitions.definitionEn: One that is harmed—killed, injured, subjected to oppression, deceived, or otherwise adversely affected—by someone or something, especially another person or event, force, or condition; in particular:

example.en: the youngest victims of the brutal war
example.ja: この残忍な戦争の最年少の犠牲者は

definitions.definitionEn: A living being which is slain and offered as a sacrifice, usually in a religious rite.

meaning: (…で)〈人〉を脅す,脅迫する《+名〈人〉+with+名》 / …を言って脅す / 〈災害などが〉…を脅かす,の脅威となる / 〈物事が〉…の前兆となる,おそれがある / 脅す,脅迫する

definitions.definitionEn: To make a threat against someone; to use threats.

example.en: He threatened me with a knife.
example.ja: ナイフで脅された

definitions.definitionEn: To menace, or be dangerous.

example.en: The rocks threatened the ship's survival.
example.ja: 岩は船の生存を脅かした。

definitions.definitionEn: To portend, or give a warning of.

example.en: The black clouds threatened heavy rain.
example.ja: 黒い雲が豪雨を引き起こしました。

definitions.definitionEn: To be close to equaling or surpassing (a record, etc.)

meaning: 〈U〉分けること,分割,分離;分配 / 〈C〉(分割された)部分 / 〈U〉(意見・感情の相違による)分裂,不一致,不和 / 〈U〉割り算 / 〈C〉仕切り;境界線 / 〈C〉(官庁・会社の)部門;(大学の)学部 / 〈C〉《集合的に》(陸軍で)師団;(海軍で)分艦隊 / 〈C〉(英議会の)票決,採決

definitions.definitionEn: The act or process of dividing anything.
Each of the separate parts of something resulting from division.
The process of dividing a number by another.
A calculation that involves this process.

example.en: I've got ten divisions to do for my homework.
example.ja: 宿題に10の区分がある

definitions.definitionEn: A formation, usually made up of two or three brigades.
A usually high-level section of a large company or conglomerate.
A rank below kingdom and above class, particularly used of plants or fungi, also (particularly of animals) called a phylum; a taxon at that rank.

example.en: Magnolias belong to the division Magnoliophyta.
example.ja: マグノリアはマグヌリフィタ部門に属する

definitions.definitionEn: A disagreement; a difference of viewpoint between two sides of an argument.
A method by which a legislature is separated into groups in order to take a better estimate of vote than a voice vote.

example.en: The House of Commons has voted to approve the third reading of the bill without a division. The bill will now progress to the House of Lords.
example.ja: 議院は、当該議定書の第3項の区分を区分なく承認することを議決した. 法案は、今から主院へ進行する。

definitions.definitionEn: A florid instrumental variation of a melody in the 17th and 18th centuries, originally conceived as the dividing of each of a succession of long notes into several short ones.
A set of pipes in a pipe organ which are independently controlled and supplied.
A concept whereby a common group of debtors are only responsible for their proportionate sum of the total debt.
Any of the four major parts of a COBOL program source code
(Eton College) A lesson; a class.

meaning: 安定した,確実性のある,保証されている / 安全な / 心配(疑い)のない / (土台などが)どっかりした,固定した / 《文》(特に努力して)…を手に入れる,獲得する / (危険・被害・損失などから)…を守る,保護する《+名+from(against)+名》 / (…に)を固定させる,しっかり留める《+名+to+名》 / 〈結果など〉をもたらす,確実にする

definitions.definitionEn: To make safe; to relieve from apprehensions of, or exposure to, danger; to guard; to protect.
To put beyond hazard of losing or of not receiving; to make certain; to assure; frequently with against or from, or formerly with of.

example.en: to secure a creditor against loss; to secure a debt by a mortgage
example.ja: 債権者を損失から守るために、債権を担保によって確保する

definitions.definitionEn: To make fast; to close or confine effectually; to render incapable of getting loose or escaping.

example.en: to secure a prisoner; to secure a door, or the hatches of a ship
example.ja: 又は船のふくろをふさぐ。

definitions.definitionEn: To get possession of; to make oneself secure of; to acquire certainly.

example.en: to secure an estate
example.ja: 不動産の確保に

definitions.definitionEn: To plight or pledge.
Free from attack or danger; protected.
Free from the danger of theft; safe.
Free from the risk of eavesdropping, interception or discovery; secret.
Free from anxiety or doubt; unafraid.
Firm and not likely to fail; stable.
Free from the risk of financial loss; reliable.
Confident in opinion; not entertaining, or not having reason to entertain, doubt; certain; sure; commonly used with of.

example.en: secure of a welcome
example.ja: 歓迎の約束だ

definitions.definitionEn: Overconfident; incautious; careless.

meaning: 装置、機器
example: This device measures the amount of light in the room.

definitions.definitionEn: Any piece of equipment made for a particular purpose, especially a mechanical or electrical one.

example.en: There are a number of household devices in a kitchen such as a dishwasher, a garbage disposal, or an electric can opener.
example.ja: 台所には皿洗い機、ごみ処理場、電気缶などの家庭用機器が数多くあります。

definitions.definitionEn: A peripheral device; an item of hardware.
A project or scheme, often designed to deceive; a stratagem; an artifice.
An improvised explosive device, home-made bomb
A technique that an author or speaker uses to evoke an emotional response in the audience; a rhetorical device.

A motto, emblem, or other mark used to distinguish the bearer from others. A device differs from a badge or cognizance primarily because as it is a personal distinction, and not a badge borne by members of the same house successively.
Power of devising; invention; contrivance.
An image used in whole or in part as a trademark or service mark.
An image or logo denoting official or proprietary authority or provenience.
A spectacle or show.
Opinion; decision.

meaning: ラベル、分類する

definitions.definitionEn: A small ticket or sign giving information about something to which it is attached or intended to be attached.

example.en: Although the label priced this poster at three pounds, I got it for two.
example.ja: ラベルは3ポンドで買ったけど 2ドルで買ったの

definitions.definitionEn: A name given to something or someone to categorise them as part of a particular social group.

example.en: Ever since he started going to the rock club, he's been given the label "waster".
example.ja: ロック・クラブに行ってからずっと"ワスター"のラベルをもらった

definitions.definitionEn: A company that sells records.

example.en: The label signed the band after hearing a demo tape.
example.ja: そのラベルはデモテープを聴いた後バンドに署名した。

definitions.definitionEn: A user-defined alias for a numerical designation, the reverse of an enumeration.

example.en: Storage devices can be given by label or ID.
example.ja: ストレージデバイスは、ラベルまたは ID で与えることができます。

definitions.definitionEn: A named place in source code that can be jumped to using a GOTO or equivalent construct.
A charge resembling the strap crossing the horse’s chest from which pendants are hung.
A tassel.
A piece of writing added to something, such as a codicil appended to a will.
A brass rule with sights, formerly used with a circumferentor to take altitudes.
The projecting moulding by the sides, and over the tops, of openings in mediaeval architecture.
In mediaeval art, the representation of a band or scroll containing an inscription.
A non-interactive control or widget displaying text, often used to describe the purpose of another control.
To put a label (a ticket or sign) on (something).

example.en: The shop assistant labeled all the products in the shop.
example.ja: 店の助手は、店の中の製品すべてにラベルを付けました。

definitions.definitionEn: (ditransitive) To give a label to (someone or something) in order to categorise that person or thing.

example.en: He's been unfairly labeled as a cheat, although he's only ever cheated once.
example.ja: 一度しか裏切ったことはないが不公平な顔で騙された

definitions.definitionEn: To replace specific atoms by their isotope in order to track the presence or movement of this isotope through a reaction, metabolic pathway or cell.
To add a detectable substance, either transiently or permanently, to a biological substance in order to track the presence of the label-substance combination either in situ or in vitro

meaning: 《しばしば複数形で》根 / 根元 / 《the~》根源,根本;根底 / 《複数形で》(その人の根底にある)ある場所との根源的なつながり / (数学で)根,ルート / (派生語の)語根(例えばrootlessの中のroot) / 〈植物〉を根づかせる / 《しばしば受動態で》(根をおろしたように)(…に)…を定着させる《+名+to(in)+名》 / (…に)根を下ろす,定着する《+in(on,to)+名》 / 〈豚などが〉(…をあさって)鼻で地面を掘る《+about(around)for+名》 / (…を捜して)〈人が〉かき回す《+about for+名》 / (…を)声援する,(…の)成功を願う《+for+名》

definitions.definitionEn: The part of a plant, generally underground, that anchors and supports the plant body, absorbs and stores water and nutrients, and in some plants is able to perform vegetative reproduction.

example.en: This tree's roots can go as deep as twenty metres underground.
example.ja: この木の根は地下20メートルの深みにまで潜ることができる。

definitions.definitionEn: A root vegetable.
The part of a tooth extending into the bone holding the tooth in place.

example.en: Root damage is a common problem of overbrushing.
example.ja: 根本的な害は、歯ぎしりしすぎることによくある問題です。

definitions.definitionEn: The part of a hair under the skin that holds the hair in place.

example.en: The root is the only part of the hair that is alive.
example.ja: 根は、生きている毛髪の唯一の部分です。

definitions.definitionEn: The part of a hair near the skin that has not been dyed, permed, or otherwise treated.

example.en: He dyed his hair black last month, so the grey roots can be seen.
example.ja: 先月は髪を黒に染めただからグレーの根が見える

definitions.definitionEn: The primary source; origin.

example.en: The love of money is the root of all evil.
example.ja: 金への愛はあらゆる悪の根源である。

definitions.definitionEn: Of a number or expression, a number which, when raised to a specified power, yields the specified number or expression.

example.en: The cube root of 27 is 3.
example.ja: 3 の 3乗は 3 です。

definitions.definitionEn: A square root (understood if no power is specified; in which case, “the root of” is often abbreviated to “root”).

example.en: Multiply by root 2.
example.ja: 平方根2で乗算します。

definitions.definitionEn: A zero (of an equation).
The single node of a tree that has no parent.
The primary lexical unit of a word, which carries the most significant aspects of semantic content and cannot be reduced into smaller constituents. Inflectional stems often derive from roots.
(philology) A word from which another word or words are derived.
The fundamental tone of any chord; the tone from whose harmonics, or overtones, a chord is composed.
The lowest place, position, or part.

In UNIX terminology, the first user account with complete access to the operating system and its configuration, found at the root of the directory structure; the person who manages accounts on a UNIX system.

example.en: I have to log in as root before I do that.
example.ja: rootでログインします。

definitions.definitionEn: The highest directory of a directory structure which may contain both files and subdirectories.

example.en: I installed the files in the root directory.
example.ja: ルートディレクトリにファイルをインストールした

definitions.definitionEn: A penis, especially the base of a penis.
To grow roots; to enter the earth, as roots; to take root and begin to grow.

example.en: The cuttings are starting to root.
example.ja: 切り傷が根を張ってる

definitions.definitionEn: To prepare, oversee, or otherwise cause the rooting of cuttings

example.en: We rooted some cuttings last summer.
example.ja: 去年の夏にいくつかのカットをルートしました。

definitions.definitionEn: To be firmly fixed; to be established.
To get root or priviledged access on a computer system or mobile phone, often through bypassing some security mechanism.

example.en: I want to root my Android phone so I can remove the preinstalled crapware.
example.ja: Androidの携帯電話を再起動したい

definitions.definitionEn: An act of sexual intercourse.

example.en: Fancy a root?
example.ja: 根が気になる?

definitions.definitionEn: A sexual partner.
To turn up or dig with the snout.

example.en: A pig roots the earth for truffles.
example.ja: ブタはホタルバエのために地面に根を下ろします。

definitions.definitionEn: (by extension) To seek favour or advancement by low arts or grovelling servility; to fawn.
To rummage; to search as if by digging in soil.

example.en: rooting about in a junk-filled drawer
example.ja: ごみ箱の引き出しに根をおろして

definitions.definitionEn: To root out; to abolish.
To have sexual intercourse.
(with "for" or "on") To cheer (on); to show support (for) and hope for the success of. (See root for.)

example.en: I'm rooting for you, don't let me down!
example.ja: お前を応援してる失望させないで!

meaning: 〈U〉支出,出費 / 〈C〉出費の原因 / 〈U〉《時にan,》(…の)費用《+of+名》 / 〈U〉損失,犠牲 / 《複数形で》経費,諸経費

definitions.definitionEn: A spending or consuming, often a disbursement of funds.

example.en: Buying the car was a big expense, but will be worth it in the long run.
example.ja: 車を買うには多額の費用がかかりましたが、長い目で見ればそれだけの価値があります。

definitions.definitionEn: The elimination or consumption of something, sometimes with the notion of loss or damage to the thing eliminated.

example.en: Jones reached the final at the expense of Smith, who couldn't beat him.
example.ja: ジョーンズはスミスの犠牲で決勝に達した

definitions.definitionEn: Loss.
To charge a cost against an expense account; to bill something to the company for which one works.

example.en: It should be acceptable to expense a business lunch with a client.
example.ja: 顧客とのビジネスランチの経費を負担すべきである。

meaning: 〈C〉水路(川・湾・運河の船の通行ができる深い部分) / 〈U〉河床・川底 / 〈C〉海峡 / 〈C〉みぞ(groove),(道路の)水渠(すいきょ) / 《複数形で》(運搬・伝達の)正式の経路(手続き);(一般に)経路 / 〈C〉(テレビ・ラジオの)チャンネル / …に水路を開く / …にみぞを掘る / …を伝える,流す

definitions.definitionEn: The physical confine of a river or slough, consisting of a bed and banks.

example.en: The water coming out of the waterwheel created a standing wave in the channel.
example.ja: 水車から流れ出る水は、チャンネルに浮かんでいる波を生んだ。

definitions.definitionEn: The natural or man-made deeper course through a reef, bar, bay, or any shallow body of water.

example.en: A channel was dredged to allow ocean-going vessels to reach the city.
example.ja: 海路の通航船が街に届くようにするチャンネルが掘られた。

definitions.definitionEn: The navigable part of a river.

example.en: We were careful to keep our boat in the channel.
example.ja: 私たちは船を水路に入れないように気をつけました。

definitions.definitionEn: A narrow body of water between two land masses.

example.en: The English Channel lies between France and England.
example.ja: イギリス海峡はフランスと英国の間にあります。

definitions.definitionEn: Something through which another thing passes; a means of conveying or transmitting.

example.en: The news was conveyed to us by different channels.
example.ja: そのニュースは様々なチャンネルによって伝えられました。

definitions.definitionEn: A gutter; a groove, as in a fluted column.
A connection between initiating and terminating nodes of a circuit.

example.en: The guard-rail provided the channel between the downed wire and the tree.
example.ja: 守衛線は下線線と木との間のチャンネルを供給した。

definitions.definitionEn: The narrow conducting portion of a MOSFET transistor.
(communication) The part that connects a data source to a data sink.

example.en: A channel stretches between them.
example.ja: その間にはチャンネルが広がっています。

definitions.definitionEn: (communication) A path for conveying electrical or electromagnetic signals, usually distinguished from other parallel paths.

example.en: We are using one of the 24 channels.
example.ja: 24チャンネルのいずれかを使用しています。

definitions.definitionEn: (communication) A single path provided by a transmission medium via physical separation, such as by multipair cable.

example.ja: 空には奇妙な姿が見られました。

definitions.definitionEn: The way something looks; personal presence
Apparent likeness; the way which something or someone appears to others.

example.en: Some people say I'm shallow because I care so much about my appearance.
example.ja: 人は、私が浅く見えるのは、私の容貌を気にかけるからといふ人もいる。

definitions.definitionEn: That which is not substance, essence, hypostasis; the outward reality as opposed to the underlying reality

example.en: Catholicism teaches that the Eucharist, while remaining under the physical appearance of bread and wine, becomes really and truly the body and the blood of Christ.
example.ja: カトリック教の教えによれば、聖体祭儀は、パンとぶどう酒の形をしたままでいるとはいえ、実際にはキリストの体と血になります。

definitions.definitionEn: The act of appearing in a particular place, or in society, a company, or any proceedings; a coming before the public in a particular character.

example.en: A person makes his appearance as an historian, an artist, or an orator.
example.ja: 人は歴史家、芸術家、あるいは託宣師として登場します。

definitions.definitionEn: An instance of someone coming into a court of law to be part of a trial, either in person or represented by an attorney or such like; a court appearance
Chiefly used by nurses: the act of defecation by a patient.

example.en: The patient had a small bowel obstruction and there was no appearance until after the obstruction resolved.
example.ja: 患者は小腸障害があり、当該障害が解決されるまでは、外見が少なかった。

meaning: (人が)理性的な,分別のある / (物事が)理にかなった,公正の,適度な・(価格が)手ごろな

definitions.definitionEn: Having the faculty of reason; rational, reasoning.
Just; fair; agreeable to reason.
Not excessive or immoderate; within due limits; proper.

example.en: a reasonable demand, amount, or price
example.ja: 合理的な需要、金額又は価格

definitions.definitionEn: Not expensive; fairly priced.

example.en: $20 a bottle is very reasonable for a good wine at a restaurant.
example.ja: ボトル20ドルはレストランで美味しいワインを

definitions.definitionEn: Satisfactory.

example.en: The builders did a reasonable job, given the short notice.
example.ja: 建設者たちは、短期的な知らせを受けて、道理にかなった仕事を行ないました。

meaning: (またguaranty)(商品に対する品質・修理・期間などの)保証;保証書 / =guaranty1,2 / 保証を受ける人,被保証人 / =guarantor / 〈商品・品質,契約の履行など〉を保証する,請け合う

definitions.definitionEn: Anything that assures a certain outcome.

example.en: Can you give me a guarantee that he will be fit for the match?
example.ja: 彼が試合に合うと保証してくれる?

definitions.definitionEn: A legal assurance of something, e.g. a security for the fulfillment of an obligation.
More specifically, a written declaration that a certain product will be fit for a purpose and work correctly; a warranty

example.en: The cooker comes with a five-year guarantee.
example.ja: コックは5年分の保証金を持って来る。

definitions.definitionEn: The person to whom a guarantee is made.
A person who gives such a guarantee; a guarantor.
To give an assurance that something will be done right.
To assume or take responsibility for a debt or other obligation.
To make something certain.

example.en: The long sunny days guarantee a good crop.
example.ja: 長い日は良い収穫を保証します。

meaning: 《継続を表す動詞と共に用いて》…まで[ずっと] / 《否定表現に続けて》…まで[…ない],…になって初めて[…する] / 《肯定の主節とともに》…まで[ずっと] / 《結果》…してそして[ついに]… / 《否定の主節に続けて》…まで[…ない],…して初めて[…する] / (商店・銀行などの)金銭入れ(引き出し・箱など) / 〈土地〉を耕す〈自〉土地を耕す,耕作する

definitions.definitionEn: Until; to, up to; as late as (a given time).

example.en: I have to work till eight o'clock tonight.
example.ja: 今夜8時まで働かないと

definitions.definitionEn: To, up to (physically).

example.en: They led him till his tent
example.ja: 彼らは彼をその天幕に導かれた

definitions.definitionEn: To make it possible that.
Until, until the time that.

example.en: Maybe you can, maybe you can't: you won't know till you try.
example.ja: 試すまで分からないでしょう。

definitions.definitionEn: A cash register.
A removable box within a cash register containing the money.

example.en: Pull all the tills and lock them in the safe.
example.ja: すべての棒を引き出して金庫に鍵をかけろ

definitions.definitionEn: The contents of a cash register, for example at the beginning or end of the day or of a cashier's shift.

example.en: My count of my till was 30 dollars short.
example.ja: 私は 30 ドル ( 約 1 万 5,000 円 ) の賞金を得ました。

definitions.definitionEn: A tray or drawer in a chest.
To develop so as to improve or prepare for usage; to cultivate (said of knowledge, virtue, mind etc.).
To work or cultivate or plough (soil); to prepare for growing vegetation and crops.
To cultivate soil.
To prepare; to get.
Glacial drift consisting of a mixture of clay, sand, pebbles and boulders
Manure or other material used to fertilize land
A vetch; a tare.

meaning: 主題,論題,題[目],テーマ / (児童・生徒の)作文 / (曲の)主題,主旋律(一曲の中にさまざまに形を変えて繰り返し出てくる旋律)

definitions.definitionEn: A subject of a talk or an artistic piece; a topic.
A recurring idea; a motif.
An essay written for school.
The main melody of a piece of music, especially one that is the source of variations.
A song, or a snippet of a song, that identifies a film, a TV program, a character, etc. by playing at the appropriate time.
The collection of color schemes, sounds, artwork etc., that "skin" an environment towards a particular motif.
(grammar) The stem of a word.
Thematic relation of a noun phrase to a verb.
Theta role in generative grammar and government and binding theory.
Topic, what is generally being talked about, as opposed to rheme.
A regional unit of organisation in the Byzantine empire.
To give a theme to.

example.en: We themed the birthday party around superheroes.
example.ja: スーパーヒーローの誕生パーティーを開いた

definitions.definitionEn: To apply a theme to; to change the visual appearance and/or layout of (software).

meaning: 判断；判決

definitions.definitionEn: The act of judging.
The power or faculty of performing such operations; especially, when unqualified, the faculty of judging or deciding rightly, justly, or wisely

example.en: a man of judgment
example.ja: 一人の審判者。

definitions.definitionEn: The conclusion or result of judging; an opinion; a decision.
The act of determining, as in courts of law, what is conformable to law and justice; also, the determination, decision, or sentence of a court, or of a judge.
The final award; the last sentence.

meaning: 奇妙な,風変りな,変な / 《名詞の前にのみ用いて》(対・組のうちの)片方の,はんぱの / (一定数量を対・組などに分けた)余分の,残りの / 《名詞の前にのみ用いて》臨時の,時たまの,不定期の / 奇数の / 《しばしば整数とハイフンで結ばれて》…あまりの,端数の

definitions.definitionEn: (diminutive) An odd number.

example.en: So let's see. There are two evens here and three odds.
example.ja: コインを2回投げて表が出る確率を

definitions.definitionEn: Something left over, not forming part of a set.
Differing from what is usual, ordinary or expected.

example.en: She slept in, which was very odd.
example.ja: 彼女は寝ていたとても奇妙だった

definitions.definitionEn: Without a corresponding mate in a pair or set; unmatched; (of a pair or set) mismatched.

example.en: My cat Fluffy has odd eyes: one blue and one brown.
example.ja: 私の猫のフライフィーは妙な目を持っている青と茶色だ

definitions.definitionEn: Left over, remaining after the rest have been paired or grouped.

example.en: I'm the odd one out.
example.ja: 妙な奴だ

definitions.definitionEn: Left over or remaining (as a small amount) after counting, payment, etc.
Scattered; occasional, infrequent; not forming part of a set or pattern.

example.en: I don't speak Latin well, so in hearing a dissertation in Latin, I would only be able to make out the odd word of it.
example.ja: ラテン語はよく話せませんので、ラテン語の解禁を耳にすると、その奇妙な言葉しか解けません。

definitions.definitionEn: Not regular or planned.

example.en: He's only worked odd jobs.
example.ja: 妙な仕事をしてただけだ

definitions.definitionEn: Used or employed for odd jobs.
Numerically indivisible by two.

example.en: The product of odd numbers is also odd.
example.ja: 偶数の積も奇数です。

definitions.definitionEn: Numbered with an odd number.

example.en: How do I print only the odd pages?
example.ja: 奇数ページだけ印刷するには?

definitions.definitionEn: (in combination with a number) About, approximately; somewhat more than (an approximated round number).

example.en: There were thirty-odd people in the room.
example.ja: 部屋には30人いた

definitions.definitionEn: Out of the way, secluded.
On the left.

example.en: He served from the odd court.
example.ja: 妙な法廷で仕えた

definitions.definitionEn: Singular in excellence; matchless; peerless; outstanding.

meaning: 〈事〉をよいと認める,に賛成する / (正式に)…を認可する,承認する / 《approve of+名(doing)》(…を)承認する,賛成する

definitions.definitionEn: To sanction officially; to ratify; to confirm; to set as satisfactory.

example.en: Although we may disagree with it, we must nevertheless approve the sentence handed down by the court-martial.
example.ja: )に異議を唱えるかもしれないが、なお、裁判所が提出した判決を承認しなければならない。

definitions.definitionEn: To regard as good; to commend; to be pleased with; to think well of.

example.en: We approve the measure of the administration, for it is an excellent decision.
example.ja: 我々は行政の定めを承認するそれは優れた決断だから

definitions.definitionEn: To make proof of; to demonstrate; to prove or show practically.
(followed by "of") To consider worthy (to); to be pleased (with); to accept.

example.en: Her mother never approves of any of her boyfriends. She thinks nobody is good enough for her little girl.
example.ja: 母親はボーイフレンドを認めない

definitions.definitionEn: To show to be worthy; to demonstrate the merits of.
(English law) To make profit of; to convert to one's own profit — said especially of waste or common land appropriated by the lord of the manor.

meaning: 〈U〉(…の)貸し付け《+of+名》 / 〈C〉貸し付け金,貸与物 / 《loan+名〈間〉+名〈直〉=loan+名+to+名》《米》…に…を貸す(《英》lend)

definitions.definitionEn: An act or instance of lending, an act or instance of granting something for temporary use.

example.en: Because of the loan that John made to me, I was able to pay my tuition for the upcoming semester.
example.ja: ジョンが貸してくれたので、私は翌学期の授業料を払うことができました。

definitions.definitionEn: A sum of money or other property that a natural or legal person borrows from another with the condition that it be returned or repaid over time or at a later date (sometimes with interest).

example.en: All loans from the library, whether books or audio material, must be returned within two weeks.
example.ja: 図書館からの貸付けはすべて、書籍であれ音声であれ、 2 週間以内に返さなければなりません。

definitions.definitionEn: The contract and array of legal or ethical obligations surrounding a loan.

example.en: He made a payment on his loan.
example.ja: 彼は貸借対照表を支払った。

definitions.definitionEn: The permission to borrow any item.

example.en: Thank you for the loan of your lawn mower.
example.ja: 芝刈り機の貸付けをありがとう

definitions.definitionEn: To lend (something) to (someone).
A lonnen.

meaning: 定義
example: Read the definition and then choose the best example.

definitions.definitionEn: A statement of the meaning of a word or word group or a sign or symbol (dictionary definitions).
(usually with the definite article the) A clear instance conforming to the dictionary or textbook definition.
A statement expressing the essential nature of something; formulation
The action or process of defining.
The act of defining; determination of the limits.
A product of defining.
The action or power of describing, explaining, or making definite and clear.

example.en: Her comic genius is beyond definition.
example.ja: 彼女の漫画の天才は定義を超えてる

definitions.definitionEn: Clarity of visual presentation, distinctness of outline or detail.

example.en: Improve the definition of an image.
example.ja: 画像の定義を改善します。

definitions.definitionEn: Clarity, especially of musical sound in reproduction.
Sharp demarcation of outlines or limits.

example.en: A jacket with distinct waist definition.
example.ja: ウエスト定義のジャケットだ

definitions.definitionEn: The degree to which individual muscles are distinct on the body.
A statement which provides a previous declaration with a value or body of a subroutine (in the case of function).
A statement that establishes the referent of a term or notation.

meaning: (投票で)〈議長・議員など〉を選ぶ,選挙する / 《文》…を選択する;(…すること)に決定する(decide)《+to do》 / 《通例‐electの形で名詞に付けて》(まだ就任していないが)選挙された,当選した / 選ばれた / 《the~》選ばれるに値する人たち,エリート / 《時にthe~》選ばれた者,選民

definitions.definitionEn: One chosen or set apart.
In Calvinist theology, one foreordained to Heaven. In other Christian theologies, someone chosen by God for salvation.
To choose or make a decision (to do something)
To choose (a candidate) in an election
Who has been elected in a specified post, but has not yet entered office.

example.en: He is the President elect.
example.ja: 大統領選だ

definitions.definitionEn: Chosen; taken by preference from among two or more.

meaning: 大気、雰囲気
example: The Earth's atmosphere protects life from harmful radiation.

definitions.definitionEn: The gases surrounding the Earth or any astronomical body.
The air in a particular place.
The apparent mood felt in an environment.
A unit of measurement for pressure equal to 101325 Pa (symbol: atm)

meaning: 農家

definitions.definitionEn: A person who works the land and/or who keeps livestock, especially on a farm.
Agent noun of farm; someone or something that farms.
One who takes taxes, customs, excise, or other duties, to collect for a certain rate per cent.

example.en: a farmer of the revenues
example.ja: 読売新聞によると

definitions.definitionEn: The lord of the field, or one who farms the lot and cope of the crown.

meaning: (…と…との)比較《+of+名+with(to)+名》;(…間の)比較《+between+名》 / (…を…に)たえること《+of+名+with(to)+名》 / (形容詞・副詞の)比較変化

definitions.definitionEn: The act of comparing or the state or process of being compared.

example.en: to bring a thing into comparison with another;  there is no comparison between them
example.ja: 比較して引き出すことは、決して出来ない。

definitions.definitionEn: An evaluation of the similarities and differences of one or more things relative to some other or each-other.

example.en: He made a careful comparison of the available products before buying anything.
example.ja: 何かを買う前に、入手可能な製品を注意深く比較しました。

definitions.definitionEn: With a negation, the state of being similar or alike.

example.en: There really is no comparison between the performance of today's computers and those of a decade ago.
example.ja: 10年前と比べれば、実際、今日のコンピュータの性能と比べ物にならない。

definitions.definitionEn: (grammar) The ability of adjectives and adverbs to form three degrees, as in hot, hotter, hottest.
That to which, or with which, a thing is compared, as being equal or like; illustration; similitude.
A simile.
The faculty of the reflective group which is supposed to perceive resemblances and contrasts.

meaning: 特有の,独特の / 特性,特色,特徴

definitions.definitionEn: A distinguishing feature of a person or thing.
The integer part of a logarithm.
The distinguishing features of a navigational light on a lighthouse etc by which it can be identified (colour, pattern of flashes etc.).

For a given field or ring, a natural number that is either the smallest positive number n such that n instances of the multiplicative identity (1) summed together yield the additive identity (0) or, if no such number exists, the number 0.

example.en: The characteristic of a field, if non-zero, must be a prime number.
example.ja: 0以外のフィールドの特徴は、素数でなければなりません。

definitions.definitionEn: Being a distinguishing feature of a person or thing.

meaning: 〈U〉〈C〉(法的な)許可,免許,認可 / 〈C〉許可証,免許状;鑑札 / 〈U〉勝手気まま,放縦 / 〈U〉(詩・音楽などの)破格 / 〈法機関が〉…に許可を与える;(…することを)…に許可する《+名+to do》

definitions.definitionEn: A legal document giving official permission to do something; a permit.
The legal terms under which a person is allowed to use a product, especially software.
Freedom to deviate deliberately from normally applicable rules or practices (especially in behaviour or speech).
Excessive freedom; lack of due restraint.
Short for driver's license.

example.en: In order to enter the building, I need to show my license.
example.ja: 建物に入るには、免許証を見せなければならない。

definitions.definitionEn: To give a formal (usually written) authorization.

example.en: It was decided to license Wikipedia under the GFDL.
example.ja: GFDLによりウィキペディアのライセンスを採択された。

definitions.definitionEn: Authorize officially.

example.en: I am licensed to practice law in this state.
example.ja: 私は、この州において法を施行する権限を有する。

meaning: あてにする,たよる

definitions.definitionEn: (with on or upon, formerly also with in) to trust; to have confidence in; to depend.

meaning: 狭い

definitions.definitionEn: (chiefly in the plural) A narrow passage, especially a contracted part of a stream, lake, or sea; a strait connecting two bodies of water.

example.en: the narrows of New York harbor
example.ja: ニューヨーク港の狭さ

definitions.definitionEn: Having a small width; not wide; having opposite edges or sides that are close, especially by comparison to length or depth.

example.en: a narrow hallway
example.ja: 狭い廊下

definitions.definitionEn: Of little extent; very limited; circumscribed.
Restrictive; without flexibility or latitude.

example.en: a narrow interpretation
example.ja: 狭義の解釈

definitions.definitionEn: Contracted; of limited scope; bigoted

example.en: a narrow mind
example.ja: 心が狭い

definitions.definitionEn: Having a small margin or degree.

example.en: The Republicans won by a narrow majority.
example.ja: 共和党は過半数を獲得した。

definitions.definitionEn: Limited as to means; straitened

example.en: narrow circumstances
example.ja: 狭い状況

definitions.definitionEn: Parsimonious; niggardly; covetous; selfish.
Scrutinizing in detail; close; accurate; exact.
Formed (as a vowel) by a close position of some part of the tongue in relation to the palate; or (according to Bell) by a tense condition of the pharynx; distinguished from wide.
To reduce in width or extent; to contract.

example.en: We need to narrow the search.
example.ja: 検索を絞り込む必要がある

definitions.definitionEn: To get narrower.

example.en: The road narrows.
example.ja: 道は狭い

definitions.definitionEn: (of a person or eyes) To partially lower one's eyelids in a way usually taken to suggest a defensive, aggressive or penetrating look.

example.en: He stepped in front of me, narrowing his eyes to slits.
example.ja: 私の前に立ち、目を狭めて切り裂いてくれました。

definitions.definitionEn: To contract the size of, as a stocking, by taking two stitches into one.
To convert to a data type that cannot hold as many distinct values.

example.en: to narrow an int variable to a short variable
example.ja: をクリックして、入力変数を短い変数に制限します。

meaning: 正体、独自性
example: Local food is part of the region's cultural identity.

definitions.definitionEn: Sameness, identicalness; the quality or fact of (several specified things) being the same.

The difference or character that marks off an individual or collective from the rest of the same kind, selfhood, sense of who something or someone or oneself is, or the recurring characteristics that enable the recognition of such an individual or group by others or themself.

example.en: I've been through so many changes, I have no sense of identity.
example.ja: 私は多くの変化を経験してきた、私はアイデンティティの感覚がありません。

definitions.definitionEn: A name or persona—a mask or appearance one presents to the world—by which one is known.

example.en: This criminal has taken on several identities.
example.ja: この犯人は数人の身分を主張した

definitions.definitionEn: An equation which always holds true regardless of the choice of input variables.
Any function which maps all elements of its domain to themselves.
An element of an algebraic structure which, when applied to another element under an operation in that structure, yields this second element.
A well-known or famous person.

example.en: 2013 April 4, "Cricket identities consult lawyers", New Zealand Herald
example.ja: 2013年4月4日閲覧. ^ "クリプト個人情報弁護士に相談". ニュージーランド・ヘラルド。

meaning: 机

definitions.definitionEn: A table, frame, or case, in past centuries usually with a sloping top but now usually with a flat top, for the use of writers and readers. It often has a drawer or repository underneath.

A reading table or lectern to support the book from which the liturgical service is read, differing from the pulpit from which the sermon is preached; also (especially in the United States), a pulpit. Hence, used symbolically for the clerical profession.
A department of a newspaper tasked with covering a particular geographical region or aspect of the news.

example.en: city desk
example.ja: 市役所

definitions.definitionEn: To shut up, as in a desk; to treasure.
To equip with a desk or desks.

meaning: 〈人が〉…を許可する / 〈物事が〉…の機会を与える,を可能にする / 〈事が〉許す / 許可証(書)

definitions.definitionEn: An artifact or document rendering something allowed or legal.

example.en: A construction permit can be obtained from the town offices.
example.ja: 町の事務所から建設許可を得ることができます。

definitions.definitionEn: Formal permission.
To allow (something) to happen, to give permission for.
To allow (someone) to do something; to give permission to.
To allow for, to make something possible.
To allow, to admit (of).
(pronounced like noun) To grant formal authorization for (something).

example.en: The Building Department permitted that project last week.
example.ja: 国土交通省は先週このプロジェクトを承認した。

definitions.definitionEn: (pronounced like noun) To attempt to obtain or succeed in obtaining formal authorization for (something).

example.en: We've been busy permitting the State Street development.
example.ja: 国土交通省の整備を許可するのに忙しいんだ

definitions.definitionEn: To hand over, resign (something to someone).
A pompano of the species Trachinotus falcatus.

meaning: 真剣に,まじめに,本気で / 重大に,ひどく

definitions.definitionEn: (manner) In a serious or literal manner.

example.en: He was hoping that we would take him seriously.
example.ja: 彼は私たちが真剣に受け止めてくれることを願っていました。

definitions.definitionEn: Gravely; deeply; very much.

example.en: That was a seriously unpleasant thing to say.
example.ja: 本当に不愉快な言葉だった

definitions.definitionEn: Used to attempt to introduce a serious point in a less serious conversation

example.en: Now, seriously, why did you forget to feed the cat today?
example.ja: なぜ今日猫を飼うのを忘れたの?

definitions.definitionEn: Used to call back to a previous point, either in disbelief or emphasis

example.en: You baked 10 cakes. Seriously, why did you do that?
example.ja: 10個のケーキを焼くのになぜあんな事を?

meaning: (植物・果実・はちみつなどが)野生の / (鳥獣などが)野生の,飼い慣らされていない / (人・気性などが)乱暴な,無法な,手に負えない / 《おもに補語に用いて》気違いじみた,熱狂的な,ひどく興奮した / 《補語にのみ用いて》熱望して;夢中になって / (天候・海・時勢などが)荒れた,激しい / (人・種族などが)未開の / (土地などが)自然のままの,荒涼とした / (計画などが)とっぴな,でたらめな / 的はずれの,見当違いの / 乱れた,だらしない / 《話》よい,愉快な / 乱暴に,やたらに;でたらめに / 荒野,荒れ地,大自然のままの状態

definitions.definitionEn: The undomesticated state of a wild animal

example.en: After mending the lion's leg, we returned him to the wild.

In fact, a category's composition operation, when restricted to a single one of its objects, turns that object's set of arrows (which would all be loops) into a monoid.
example.ja: モノイドとは、二次元の操作で「その上」に「その上の」と「アイデンティティー」が組み込まれている基礎集合であるように、カテゴリは「その上に」矢印の組成操作で、各オブジェクトの個人情報を移転させたものである. 事実、カテゴリの構成処理は、一つのオブジェクトに限定したときは、そのオブジェクトの矢印(すべてはループしている)を単独化させる。

example.ja: カメラをパソコン画面にワイヤーします

example.ja: サラに気を配らせるのは無駄だ

example.ja: その刑事は、その逃亡者が駅で逮捕されることを期待して、前方にワイヤーを張りました。
